Plan deliberately expands beyond the four declared file_scope entries: the research report's highest-leverage fix (wiring the already-computed stall_suspected signal into skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md's loop) lives outside declared scope, as do docs/architecture/orchestrate-state-machine.md (mt_state_file field reference) and context/standards/status-markers.md (where the exclusion contract lives, per scope item 2's own instruction). Scope item 3 cannot be closed actionably without the SKILL.md edit. Expansion is recorded in the plan's Goals/Scope Decision section; file_scope amendment happens automatically via plan-file-scope-harvest.sh at this dispatch's postflight.
